data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, September 8, 2026: Crypto prices sliding as U.S.-Iran fighting continues
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $79,093.85 on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, down 1.6% from Monday's open. As of 7:20 a.m. ET, the price of bitcoin fell to $78,370.62. Ethereum opened at $2,489.84 today, down 1% from Monday's opening price. The price of ethereum edged lower to $2,473.66 as of 7:20 a.m. ET.
